We have applied template 1037371 to the molecule (first precursor from earlier). The result is a tuple containing a tuple of SMILES strings? It shows "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=O)C[C@H](OC(=O)/C=C/C=C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)[C@H]1C)CO',),)". So the precursor list is a single SMILES: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=O)C[C@H](OC(=O)/C=C/C=C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)[C@H]1C)CO'.

But the task: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl2-template_search-3 to the molecule below". The molecule below is from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-2 answer: list of two SMILES: ['C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO', 'COP(=O)(CC(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)OC'].

So we need to apply the template (template_id 1037371) to each of those? The template is for DIBAL-H reduction of ester to aldehyde? The first SMILES is a cyclic compound with an OH group; the second is a phosphate with silyl group maybe protecting group. The template likely applies to the ester group (C(=O)O...). The second SMILES contains an ester? It has "COP(=O)(CC(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)OC". That's a phosphate with a carbonyl? Actually "CC(=O)O[Si]" is an ester of acetic acid with silyl. The template may apply to that carbonyl to give aldehyde? Not sure.

We should apply template to both SMILES. Let's try for second.
